## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tilarán, Costa Rica. It starts at Sett road entrance next to the Lake Arenal dam.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Pristine waterfalls, an endless expanse of green rainforest, and the chance to see sloths peacefully hanging around in their natural habitat. Could this be paradise?
>
> The Mistico Hanging Bridges Walk is a comfortable, non-slip trail through the Costa Rican canopies. Let the stunning local flora and fauna revitalize you, and admire some of the most impressive natural beauty on the planet.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €39.49. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 74 ratings and 47 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
